mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 72 degrees at Fireman's Park under a New Moon. We are expecting an overnight low of 67 degrees, and thankfully, no rain is in the forecast.

In city news, please be advised that road construction on Highway M begins August 18, which will include traffic shifts and temporary closures near the Kwik Trip entrance. Also, keep an eye out for upcoming public meetings regarding development projects at South Main Street and in the Liberty Business Park.

There is plenty to do in town today. You can catch live music at Paddy Mac's, hit up the yoga studio, browse the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, grab a pizza and a pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company, or join a trivia night at The Mill or The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, we have Concerts in the Park tomorrow at Century School Park.
Regarding the weekly police report, an officer observed a driver on August 6 speeding and driving erratically, resulting in an arrest for O W I, fourth offence.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store is currently closed, but they will reopen at 10 AM tomorrow when you can try tomorrow's flavor, Devil's Food Cake.
